description:
Log in to Moodle as admin (username: admin, password: Admin1234!) at http://localhost/moodle.

Navigate to the course "World History" (HIST201). Set up student groups for collaborative discussions:

1. Go to the course participants or course administration area and find the Groups management page.

2. Create the first group:
   - Group name: "Discussion Group A"
   - Group description: "Group for discussing ancient civilizations topics"
   - Add members: Bob Brown (bbrown) and Carol Garcia (cgarcia)

3. Create the second group:
   - Group name: "Discussion Group B"
   - Group description: "Group for discussing modern history topics"
   - Add member: David Lee (dlee)

4. Set the course group mode to "Separate groups" in the course settings (Edit settings > Groups > Group mode > Separate groups).
